public.text: Implementation guidance should better address settings with intermittent connectivity, limited ICT staffing, laboratory equipment dependencies and the need to protect samples and data during outages.
public.suggestedRevision: Include offline-first workflows, barcode-based identification, local caching of terminology, queued synchronisation, secure backups, disaster recovery, cybersecurity controls, temperature-monitoring interfaces, equipment-maintenance integration and sustainable local technical capacity.
